Oh yeah, you did say "seed starter pot". :)

I'm a big fan of bottom watering. Something I've been experimenting with is growing in Wal-Mart re-usable fabric bags. Fill 'em as deep as you like (fully for larger fruiting plants), transplant your start, and set the whole bag in a plastic container with an inch or two of water. Be sure to top water at first to start the wicking action, then just maintain the water level in the container. The plant drinks just as much as it needs, and the evaporative action from the bag keeps the root ball cool even on the hottest of days.
